meta.rationale: Root cause found for both open goals: bun run upsample --keywords never forced the target emoji into its rows (unlike --emojis/--group/--flags), so last iteration's 25-keyword upsample (pet/health/hammer/memo/...) mostly taught the model whatever emoji the annotator picked naturally, not the CLDR/ii.json target the flex-keyword probe grades against - explaining the flat 0.680->0.706 / 0.538->0.550 moves. Fixed this loop (upsample.ts: --keywords now accepts keyword=emoji to force the target, same as --emojis) and re-ran 27 keyword=emoji pairs from the worst keywords_flex misses (1349 rows, ~40-47/50 kept per keyword after regen's cap). Separately, running the standard `bun run regen` (no flags - the documented default) grew the emoji vocab 287 -> 400 versus the 26-09-11-02-48 report, most likely because that report's train/eval/labels.json had been left over from a non-default regen invocation; every Acc@k number below the next training run is measured against a substantially different (larger) label space and is NOT comparable to the 26-09-11-02-48 report. Targets below are held near their prior values rather than stepped hard, since the vocab jump alone can move them either way independent of the fix's effect.
